fact: Etherscan identifies itself as a block explorer and analytics platform for Ethereum and smart contracts.
quote: Etherscan is a Block Explorer and Analytics Platform for Ethereum, a decentralized smart contracts platform.

fact: The homepage search bar can filter by addresses, tokens, name tags, domain names, labels, and websites.
quote: All Filters Addresses Tokens Name Tags Domain Names Labels Websites Search

fact: The explorer supports switching among Ethereum Mainnet, Sepolia Testnet, and Hoodi Testnet.
quote: Ethereum Mainnet Sepolia Testnet Hoodi Testnet

fact: Appearance settings offer Light, Dim, Dark, and Auto (System) modes.
quote: Appearance Light Dim Dark Auto (System)

fact: Primary navigation groups Blockchain, Transactions, Pending Transactions, Contract Internal Transactions, Cross-Chain Transactions, Beacon Deposits, Beacon Withdrawals, View Blobs, AA Transactions, and EIP-7702 Authorizations Beta.
quote: Home Blockchain Transactions Pending Transactions Contract Internal Transactions Cross-Chain Transactions Beacon Deposits Beacon Withdrawals View Blobs AA Transactions EIP-7702 Authorizations Beta

fact: The Latest Blocks card is customizable and lists block number, age, fee recipient, transaction count, and ETH reward.
quote: Latest Blocks Customize Block 26208382 12 secs ago Fee Recipient BuilderNet 203 txns in 12 secs 0 . 00589 Eth 0 . 00589 Eth

fact: The Latest Transactions card is customizable and lists transaction hash, age, from/to parties, and ETH value.
quote: Latest Transactions Customize TX# 0x83045960a70debf6242aef7f5ef7e180b77a05e031a31b19938bb19da974b0cb 12 secs ago From BuilderNet To Titan Relay: Forwarder 0 . 00439 Eth 0 . 00439 Eth

fact: Homepage cards can be customized by selecting from available card options.
quote: Custom Card Customize this card by selecting one of the options below.

fact: Advanced filtering supports saved filters and presets for Latest Blocks, Latest Transactions, Hot Contracts, and Top Guzzlers.
quote: ADVANCED FILTER Saved Filters PRESET Latest Blocks Latest Transactions Hot Contracts Top Guzzlers Close Save changes

fact: Users can assign private name tags to addresses for easier identification.
quote: My Address - Private Name Tag or Note My Name Tag: Private Name Tags (up to 35 characters) can be used for easy identification of addresses

fact: Transaction private notes are limited to 100 characters and support transaction tracking.
quote: A private note (up to 100 characters) can be saved and is useful for transaction tracking.

fact: The interface warns users not to store passwords or private keys in private notes.
quote: Please DO NOT store any passwords or private keys here.

fact: The homepage displays transaction throughput updated every 5 minutes, TPS, and median gas price.
quote: Transactions (Updated every 5 mins)'> 3,796.06 M ( 18.9 TPS) Med Gas Price Priority Fee: 0.001 Gwei'> 0.073 Gwei

fact: The explorer shows last finalized block and last safe block heights.
quote: Last Finalized Block 26208309 Last Safe Block 26208341

fact: Footer/resource navigation includes Charts And Stats, Top Statistics, Leaderboard, Directory, Newsletter, Knowledge Base, and API documentation.
quote: Charts And Stats Top Statistics Leaderboard Directory Newsletter Knowledge Base API Etherscan API API Pricing API Documentation

fact: Manifold Markets is a trading platform that gives new users a starting balance to trade with.

fact: The value proposition for signing up is receiving 1,000 units of currency to begin trading.
quote: Sign up Get 1,000 to start trading!
